csv_project_name: DB Svc for Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment
csv_scope_of_work: The Vermont Agency of Transportation (VTrans) is seeking Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from interested parties who wish to be evaluated and shortlisted for participation in future Request for Proposals (RFP) related to the design, construction, ownership, operation, and maintenance of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, also referred to as Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE), being deployed through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act National Electric Vehicle Supply Infrastructure Program. These services may include projects located both along Vermont s designated Alternative Fuel Corridors (AFCs) and within community locations beyond highway corridors.
